name: llama-moe-prefill
description: llama.cpp llama-bench, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q8_0 (36.9 GB, larger than the GPU) with -ngl 99 -ot exps=CPU: experts stay in the mmap'd file and are copied pageable HtoD for every prompt batch. Metric: prompt processing pp2048.

name: llama-load-mmap
description: llama.cpp llama-completion startup (default mmap), Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (17.6 GB) fully on the GPU, file in the page cache: weights are copied pageable HtoD from the mapping. Metric: launch to exit for a 4-token reply.

name: llama-load-nommap
description: The same startup with --no-mmap: llama.cpp reads the file into its own pinned staging buffers, so copies are pinned (control; the hook is expected to change nothing).

name: diffusers-flux2-klein
description: diffusers FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, the model card example with enable_model_cpu_offload(), 1024x1024, 4 steps: every image moves text encoder, DiT and VAE pageable HtoD and back DtoH. Metric: mean of 3 images after a warm-up image.

name: diffusers-flux2-klein-group
description: The same FLUX.2 [klein] 4B call with the pipeline's enable_group_offload(block_level, 1 block per group), use_stream left at its default False: every step copies each block pageable HtoD before it runs and back DtoH after. Metric: mean of 3 images after a warm-up image.

name: diffusers-sdxl-sequential
description: diffusers SDXL base 1.0 fp16 with enable_sequential_cpu_offload() (lowest-VRAM recipe), 1024x1024, 50 steps: every forward copies each leaf module's weights pageable HtoD (5 GB of UNet per step). Metric: mean of 3 images after a warm-up image.

name: zimage-sdnext
description: SD.Next 6657d06 server, Z-Image-Turbo bf16 txt2img through its API, 1024x1024, 9 steps, with no offload flags: SD.Next picks balanced offload for the detected VRAM, and on a 24 GB card every image still copies the text encoder, DiT and VAE pageable HtoD (20.4 GB, mostly 16-256 MB tensors) and back DtoH (20.4 GB). Metric: median of 3 images after a first image.

name: zimage-diffsynth
description: DiffSynth-Studio 08fdc0d, its Z-Image-Turbo low-VRAM example as published (bf16, 1024x1024, 8 steps, vram_limit = GPU memory - 0.5 GiB). No smaller limit is needed: on a 24 GB card every image still copies the text encoder, DiT and VAE pageable HtoD (20.5 GB, mostly 16-256 MB tensors) and offloads them DtoH (20.5 GB). Metric: median of 3 images after a first image.

name: oceananigans-3d-output
description: Oceananigans 0.117.1 ocean wind-mixing example on the GPU, 256x256x128, whole 3D fields saved every simulated minute (JLD2): each save copies every field GPU->host pageable (64 MiB each). Metric: run! time after JIT warm-up.

name: gs-3dgs-cpu
description: 3D Gaussian Splatting train.py (graphdeco-inria), T&T train scene, 7,000 iterations, --data_device cpu (README low-VRAM option): one ~8 MB training image copied pageable HtoD per iteration. Metric: whole training run.

name: gs-3dgs-gpu
description: The same 3DGS training with the default --data_device cuda: images are copied to the GPU once at load (2.4 GiB pageable HtoD), then no copies (control).

name: sb3-atari-ppo
description: Stable-Baselines3 PPO CnnPolicy on Breakout (8 envs, zoo hyperparameters), policy on the GPU, 100k env steps: each 256-sample minibatch of stacked uint8 frames is a 6.9 MiB NumPy array copied pageable HtoD. Metric: env steps/s during learn().

name: nanogpt-resume
description: nanoGPT train.py config/finetune_shakespeare.py --init_from=resume (gpt2-large; gpt2-xl does not fit 24 GB), 10 iterations: torch.load(map_location='cuda') of a 9.3 GB checkpoint copies every tensor pageable HtoD, load_state_dict copies the model DtoH and back. Setup needs the GPU once to write the checkpoint. Metric: whole run.
